note: Every amendment to the frozen v2 contract, in order. previous_sha256 chains from original_sha256 to the committed openapi_v2.json bytes; the generated client (frontend/src/generated/api-v2.ts) and its hash file are regenerated with the repository's own tooling (npm run generate:api-v2) in the same step, and the P3E freeze (deployment/governance-studio/approved-runtime-config.json frozen.openapi_v2_sha256) carries the same sha256.
original_frozen_by: GAS-4 (v2 freeze); CR-2 served it behind v1

amendments.note: Front-door seam 5: typed registration intake over ai-system-registry 0.2.0. The write records what an administrator asserted and confers nothing (registry ADR D-5); no other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-10.4 ONE_STEP_AMENDMENT (with FD-10.1 START_IS_A_RELAY, FD-10.2 SIXTH_ROUTE_START_SHADOW_RUN, FD-10.3 NO_DEFINITION_CROSSES)
amendments.note: Front-door seam 6: one relay operation asking the governed runtime worker to start the worker's own shadow run. The request carries an optional typed correlation_id and nothing else; the studio's client pins the mode word shadow and the worker's own definition digest binds the run. No other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-11.5 READ_ONLY_ONE_STEP_AMENDMENT (with FD-11.1 OBSERVE_OVER_WORKER_LEDGER, FD-11.3 SEVENTH_ROUTE_LEDGER_READ, FD-11.4 TWO_LABELLED_SOURCES)
amendments.note: Front-door seam 7: one read relaying the governed runtime worker's own tenant's audit-ledger rows for a correlation id, with the worker's chain verification, returned unchanged. The studio names no tenant and re-derives nothing. No other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-12.4 V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS (with FD-12.1 SCREEN_5_TYPED_DATA_USE_DECLARATIONS, FD-12.3 DECLARED_BY_PRESENTED_UNPROVEN, FD-12.5 DECLARE_IS_THE_ONLY_WRITE)
amendments.note: Front-door seam 8: typed data-use declaration intake over data-use-admission 0.2.0. The write records what a declarer asserted and confers nothing (DE-1, FD-12.5); data_ref is an opaque handle and no field carries the data; the classification, purpose and residency labels stay uninterpreted; declared_by is presented and unproven. No egress restriction is expressible and none is invented. No other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-13.3 V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS (with FD-13.1 SCREEN_5_TYPED_VENDOR_DECLARATIONS, FD-13.2 LOCAL_SQLITE_UNDER_RUNTIME_VOLUME, FD-13.4 RISK_POSTURE_UNINTERPRETED)
amendments.note: Front-door seam 9: typed vendor-dependency intake over vendor-dependency 0.2.0. The write records what a declarer asserted and confers nothing (VR-1, FD-13.4); vendor_ref is an opaque handle and no field carries an address, endpoint or credential; the risk posture is recorded uninterpreted and never ordered, ranked or scored, and no approval or onboarding status is expressible; policy_ref is recorded and never resolved. No other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_CLEARANCE_EXPORT_SCOPING.md CE-5 EXPORT_IS_A_READ (with CE-1 RECEIVED_CLEARANCE_ONLY, CE-3 ONE_MEMBER_NOW, CE-4 INTEGRITY_ONLY_AND_SAY_SO, CE-6 ONE_ENTRY_EXPORT_PACKAGE, CE-7 SYNTHETIC_SEEDED_RECEIPTS)
amendments.note: Clearance export: one read, and only a read. It returns the portable, content-addressed form of a clearance receipt the deployment already received (CE-1) — never one the studio minted and never a compile result; the reconstruction path refuses compile-shaped keys outright. No write, no operation that accepts a receipt, no new egress destination and no credential. The artifact carries three honesty claims that cannot be omitted, softened or stripped without changing its fingerprint: identity_assurance PRESENTED_UNPROVEN, authenticity UNSIGNED with the unfed trust-anchor prerequisite named, and data_classification SYNTHETIC_DEMONSTRATION_ONLY. The route is named exports, not clearances, so the SD-2 verb scan over operation ids and paths is left exactly as it was. No other operation changed.

amendments.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_MODULE_ADMINISTRATION_SCOPING.md MS-3 OBSERVE_DEPLOYMENT_ONE_READ (with MA-2 as amended by MS-1 SEAM_STATES_ONLY, MS-2 IN_MEMORY_RESULT_AT_COMPOSITION, MS-4 SEAM_STATES_CHECKS_AND_PINS)
amendments.note: Deployment status: one read returning the deployment's own startup integrity attestation (the six seam states, the checks map, result, failure code and pins), handed to build_studio_context once at composition and never re-read; cert_subject and cert_expiry do not travel; the console's module registry is not here by ruling MS-1; nothing is probed at request time. No other operation changed.
